Privacy policy
01

About this website

This website presents BMWebSolutionsCR services, projects and templates. You can explore the content and ask about web development, software or IT support. These terms apply to website use; service commitments are set out in the proposal or contract agreed with the client.

02

Inquiries and sessions

Completing the form, using the bot or opening WhatsApp prepares an inquiry. It does not confirm a booking or constitute a purchase. Session date, time and format are confirmed directly with our team. This website does not take payments or automatically enter into service contracts.

03

Proposals and scope

Before work begins, both parties must agree on scope, deliverables, timelines, cost and applicable payment terms. Additional requests and scope changes are reviewed before inclusion. Maintenance, visits, support and licenses are included only when agreed.

04

Client content and collaboration

For a project, the client must provide the agreed content, authorized access and reviews. The client must have permission to use supplied text, brands, images and other materials. Delays in providing these items may require revising the work schedule.

05

Projects, templates and ownership

The portfolio shows work for different businesses; templates are design examples. Third-party brands and content belong to their respective owners. Displaying a template does not grant a license to copy it. Rights to project code, design, content and assets are defined in the service agreement and applicable third-party licenses.

06

Responsible use and external services

Use the contact channels for legitimate inquiries. Do not interfere with the website, access systems without authorization or send unlawful content. Links to WhatsApp, social networks, templates and projects open external services whose availability and terms depend on their providers.

07

Availability and results

The website may be updated or temporarily unavailable. Its content describes our capabilities and does not guarantee sales, search rankings or specific commercial results. Service warranties, responsibilities and support levels are agreed for each project without limiting statutory rights.

08

Privacy, questions and changes

Information handling is described in our Privacy policy. For questions about these terms or a service, email equipoventas@bmwebsolutionscr.com.

These terms are interpreted under applicable Costa Rican law. Changes will be published with an updated date and do not by themselves alter existing service agreements.
